tools.getBrowserTabs: ADE-native discovery of registered tabs with stable IDs, URL/title/ready state, and active tab.
tools.sendCDP: ADE-native tool exposing the upstream API.sendCDP capability directly, returning raw CDP JSON. It is not an upstream standalone tool name.
tools.readConsoleLogs: Upstream argument names and shape: id, filter, limit, levels, delayMs. Captures Runtime console events, exceptions and Log entries; newest first; clears on navigation.

limits: This is an intermediate native browser bridge, not complete Stagewise toolbox parity.
This bridge does not advertise or accept executeSandboxJs. The separate native QuickJS SandboxHost implements a tested subset and delegates API.sendCDP here; see audit/sandbox-native.json.
Raw screenshots are not automatically converted into multimodal model attachments by this bridge.
Cancellation stops awaiting a response; it cannot reverse or guarantee termination of an already issued page action.
Responses are limited to 2 MiB, retained console history to 1000 entries, and each retained console message to 16384 characters.
Console capture starts at tab registration; no claim is made to recover logs from before registration.
credential_boundary: BrowserToolBridge receives only explicit tool arguments and BrowserWidget references. It has no ProviderConfig, CredentialStore, API key, or provider-request access. Browser profiles are separately selectable through setProfileDirectory.
